Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Stagehand encoder matrix and registrant opt-outs

Hi Samir / ON24 Ops —

Thanks again for hopping on the call earlier. Per our discussion, I'm attaching an initial encoder matrix that maps each streaming path (ON24 RTMP, Zoom RTMP fallback, CDN relay) to the encoder profiles our production partner (Stagehand Media) will use. Key asks from our side:

- Confirm max ingest bandwidth for each encoder (we need to ensure 5Mbps ceiling for EU region).
- Confirm how ON24 surfaces the "recording consent" toggle to registrants and whether that flag is visible in the registrant export (we need per-registrant consent to be a CSV column).
- Confirm whether ON24 will strip PII from caption transcripts if a registrant opted out of recording.

Attachments: stagehand_encoder_matrix_v1.csv, registrant_optout_policy-draft.docx, preflight-checklist-ON24-zoom.pdf

Timeline: BigEnterprise's launch window is Nov 10; preflight dry run targeted Nov 4.

If you can confirm the ingest bandwidth and registrar export fields by EOD Friday (Oct 30), we can lock the encoder profiles and push the dry run invite.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
--
Jordan Blake | jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0128

From: Samir Patel <samir.p@on24.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ON24 Operations <ops@on24.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stagehand encoder matrix and registrant opt-outs

Jordan —

Appreciate the matrix and the clear asks. Quick answers:

- Max ingest bandwidth: confirmed 6 Mbps per stream for US/NA; EU region limited to 5 Mbps (we can enforce a 5 Mbps cap on encoder side for EU-facing streams).
- Registrant export: yes — ON24 includes a column "recording_consent" in the CSV export. We can add a second column for "caption_optout" if you need it surfaced.
- PII in captions: ON24 does not automatically strip PII from captions. We'd need a post-processing step (we can integrate a lambda to redact named entities before transcript storage). We can discuss options on the dry run.

I've looped ops to validate the caption post-processing approach and to share the preflight endpoint.

Samir
Samir Patel | Strategic Partnerships, ON24
samir.p@on24.com | +1 650-555-4839

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Stagehand encoder matrix and registrant opt-outs

Folks —

Forwarding Samir's answers. Highlights for our runbook:

- Use Stagehand encoder profile A for US streams (target 4.5 Mbps).
- Use profile B (5 Mbps cap) for any EU-targeted RTMP.
- ON24 will surface recording_consent (good). Need to decide if we require caption_optout field — BigEnterprise legal prefers explicit caption opt-out.
- We will likely need a redaction step for transcripts if a registrant opted out of recording but requested captions; legal asked whether we can provide captions without long-term transcript retention.

Action items:
1) Marissa — confirm whether we ask registrants a separate "caption opt-out" checkbox on the registration form (outline below). Deadline: Mon, Nov 1 EOD.
2) Ben — confirm Stagehand can produce two encoder profiles and deliver configs by Nov 2.
3) Laura — coordinate with BigEnterprise legal: do they accept captioning without transcript retention, or do they need both captured?

I've attached the matrix and the registrant opt-out draft for editing.

-J

Jordan —

Quick update after reviewing the draft registrant flow:

- I recommend adding a single, clearly worded checkbox on the registration form: "I agree to allow Redwood and BigEnterprise to record the event and retain a transcript for internal use."
- Beneath that, add a short link to our privacy page and a secondary small checkbox (not required) for "I consent to captions being generated for live accessibility purposes (captions will not be retained if you opt out of recording)." That satisfies legal's ask while keeping the primary consent flow simple for registrants.
- I'll update the registrant_optout_policy-draft.docx and push a new version to the Drive link by EOD Nov 1.

Ben — can you confirm Stagehand's delivery timeframe? If they can push encoder configs by Nov 2 we can still run the dry run Nov 4.

-Marissa

Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stagehand encoder matrix and registrant opt-outs — configs attached

All —

Stagehand will deliver two final encoder profiles today. Attached: stagehand_encoder_matrix_v1.csv (final) and a short notes file with the exact ffmpeg flags we'll use for the EU cap.

Notes:
- US profile (A): 4.5 Mbps, 1080p30, keyframe 2s, bitrate mode CBR with 650k buffer.
- EU profile (B): 5 Mbps cap enforced via limiter on the encoder box; same keyframe settings.
- We will emit a tagging header on the RTMP stream with "region=EU" or "region=US" so ON24 can route to the right ingest and transcript handling pipeline.

Marissa — thanks for the consent wording. We'll wait to see the updated doc from legal but Stagehand can hold off until we get the registrant field confirmed.

Samir / ON24 ops — please confirm receipt of the final matrix and confirm the registrant CSV will include both recording_consent and caption_optout columns for the dry run export.

-Ben

Attachments: stagehand_encoder_matrix_v1.csv
